items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: brought to a tremendous peak by Goodman and Artie Shaw and the Dorseys and Jimmy Lunceford

ctx.x: So there's always a dual thing that the music, the classical music on one level, and that level is sort of parallel to the jazz level, too, and then that big pop thing. But the nearest thing to jazz would be the big band area, started I think by Duke and Fletcher Henderson and brought to a tremendous peak by Goodman and Artie Shaw and the Dorseys and Jimmy Lunceford, That period was the nearest to blending a mass audience with good music. The music of the musicians and the public coming together, don't you think?
